card.name: Start of text right after a heading
card.fires_on: The first piece of text right after a section heading or product name in drug labels, such as the start of a new sentence, a bullet, or a capitalised brand-name part. It also fires on the split-off start of a word, like E in CLINIMIX E or In in Instruct.

modes.label: Brand name continuation
modes.description: A split-off letter or syllable right after a drug or brand name.
